note: #4168 detector only, for controls whose shader KIND differs from the repro's. SKILL.md: 'Score controls against the instrument, not an unrelated anchor' -- a library-only dump legitimately prints `Shader Version: Library` and would fail match.json's first clause without saying anything about whether the cbuffer's variables were found. This predicate keeps the anti-vacuity anchor (CB0 present at its correct size) and the symptom, and drops the shader-kind clause. Used by variant-libonly, which asks whether the annotation is already gone in the lib_6_x library before any linking happens.
